decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the core offer and aligned with the firm's organic expansion strategy, its value is still uncertain after one year and keeping it is cheap, so the option stays open.

The organic poultry mini snack is a low-cost extension of existing curing capabilities with its own web page and fits the organic direction, though a niche snack format carries some risk of being delisted by retail, so it is kept while results resolve.
The premium sharing salami line uses established processes and is cheap to maintain, and with only one year of evidence there is not yet enough negative information to justify abandoning it.
